correctness.rationale: Unique extremal ellipsoids inherit n-fold rotation and base-exchanging height reflection, forcing axial form. The lateral supporting planes are determined by bottom edges versus upper vertices, support R(A+B)/2 and signed slope R(B−A)/h. Exact John containment a²+R²(B−A)²b²/h² ≤ R²(A+B)²/4 and b≤h/2 maximizes a²b at b=h/2, yielding a²=R²AB, including prism/half-step endpoints. Löwner inclusion at all 2n vertices minimizes a²b at R²/a²=2/3, h²/(4b²)=1/3. Mixed-area integration gives Vol(K)=nhR²sin(π/n)(2A+B)/3, and d[AB/(2A+B)]/dB>0. Independent direct SciPy convex-hull calculations for n=3,4,5,7,11 and five twists tested support containment, hull volume and every outer vertex contact (25 cases). Finite checks corroborate, do not prove continuum/all n.
